user.title: Amperium
user.description: Log in with your Amperium / power company phone number. A one-time code (OTP) will be sent to you by SMS.

otp.title: Enter code
otp.description: Enter the one-time code sent by SMS to {phone}.

site.title: Choose site
site.description: Your account has several sites. Choose which one to track.

scheme.title: Compensation scheme
scheme.description: Which scheme are you on? Net cost uses the amount for this scheme. Both amounts are still shown.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Amperium needs a new login. A one-time code will be sent by SMS to {phone}. Press Submit to send it.

reauth_otp.title: Enter code
reauth_otp.description: Enter the one-time code sent by SMS to {phone}.

error.too_many_otp: Too many one-time codes requested today. Wait 24 hours and try again (power company daily limit).
error.request_otp_failed: Could not send the code. Check the phone number and try again.
error.invalid_otp: The code is invalid or expired.
error.no_sites: No sites were found for this account.

abort.already_configured: This site is already set up.
abort.reauth_failed: The integration entry could not be found.

cost_total.name: Total cost after subsidy this month (energy + grid rent, excl. fixed fee)

cost_grid_rent.name: Grid rent after subsidy this month (incl. capacity charge, excl. fixed fee)

energy_gross_month.name: Energy cost gross this month (summed from hourly data)

net_norgespris_month.name: Net cost with Norgespris (incl. fixed fee)

net_subsidy_month.name: Net cost with electricity subsidy (incl. fixed fee)

cost_grid_rent_last_month.name: Grid rent after subsidy last month (incl. capacity charge, excl. fixed fee)

cost_last_month.name: Total cost after subsidy last month (energy + grid rent, excl. fixed fee)

net_cost_month.name: Net cost this month (your scheme, incl. fixed fee)

grid_gross_month.name: Grid rent before subsidy this month (incl. capacity charge, excl. fixed fee)

subsidy_applied_month.name: Electricity subsidy applied to grid rent this month

gross_total_month.name: Total gross this month (energy + grid rent + fixed fee, before support)

spot_price_incl_vat.name: Electricity price now incl. surcharge and VAT

capacity_calc_kw.name: Capacity basis this month (calculated, three highest days)

capacity_threshold_kw.name: Threshold for a new capacity peak

init.title: Day/night hours
init.description: Local hours counted as day. All other hours count as night. Weekends and holidays are not treated specially.

data_description.power_entity: Optional. Pick a sensor with the whole house's power, e.g. Tibber Pulse/Watty. Used for live power and a forecast of this hour's average. A charger such as Easee only shows the charger's power and does not fit.

error.invalid_day_hours: Day must start before it ends.

login_expiring.title: Amperium login expires soon
login_expiring.description: Your Amperium login expires in about {days} days. Log in again with a one-time code before then: open the reconfigure/re-login prompt on the integration under Settings → Devices & services → Amperium.
